changes.why: ph_r (the checker's CPHA_b) was reloaded from i_cpha at every command handshake, including continuation/Pause handshakes while o_cs_n=0. The spec defines CPHA_b as i_cpha captured at the first acceptance edge of the burst and requires it to be used for the whole burst; changes while o_cs_n=0 have no effect (REQ-ERR-001). ph_r is now loaded only on hs && o_cs_n (burst start) and held across continuation and Pause handshakes; d_r, cnt, mp_r and busy stay per-handshake. No assertion, expected value or hit counter was relaxed.
spec_refs: spec:57 CPOL_b, CPHA_b: values captured at the first acceptance edge of the current burst

changes.why: t_cpol_b (the checker's CPOL_b) was reloaded from i_cpol at every command handshake, including continuation/Pause handshakes while o_cs_n=0. The spec defines CPOL_b as i_cpol captured at the first acceptance edge of the burst and requires it to be used for the whole burst (including Pause and Trail); changes while o_cs_n=0 have no effect. t_cpol_b is now loaded only on hs_cmd && o_cs_n (burst start) and held for the burst; t_act, t_cnt and t_last_b stay per-handshake. This fixes CHK-023, CHK-025 and the CHK-027 use of t_cpol_b. No assertion was relaxed.
spec_refs: spec:57 CPOL_b, CPHA_b: values captured at the first acceptance edge of the current burst

notes:
I fixed all six faults in the checkers only. The checker's copies of CPHA_b (ph_r in nnc_chk_mosi.sv) and CPOL_b (t_cpol_b in nnc_chk_sclk.sv) are now loaded only at a burst-start handshake (o_cs_n=1 in the cycle ending at the acceptance edge). They are kept unchanged on continuation and Pause handshakes. This follows the CPOL_b/CPHA_b definition at spec line 57, REQ-MODE-001/002/003, REQ-FLOW-005 and REQ-ERR-001. With this change the checkers still check REQ-MODE-003/REQ-ERR-001 when the inputs change mid-burst.

The faults also suggest an optional environment fix: an ENV-003 assumption in verif/formal/nnc_env.sv. I did not make it. That file is read-only, the task forbids adding assumptions, and it would remove formal checking of REQ-ERR-001. The checker fix alone resolves each counterexample.

Not changed, outside the listed faults: verif/sva/nnc_chk_rsp.sv line 89 sets cpha_r <= i_cpha at every command handshake. This looks like the same pattern for MISO sampling (CHK-020), but no fault lists it, so I left it alone. It is worth a triage review. nnc_chk_flow.sv already captures at the burst start only.
